rule: Count only actually-used scientific analysis/data tools or science libraries; generic transfer, literature search, tests, builds and source control excluded. Do not treat modules or workflows as separate tools.

used.name: Diffrax
used.evidence: upstream DBS-Gym ODE diffeqsolve executed during four action steps in src/parkinson_native.py

used.evidence: src/mimic_demo_audit.py; seven public clinical tables fetched, joined and audited for sepsis-coded admissions and four fluid/vasopressor item labels; results/sepsis_mimic_demo.json hashes/counts; no treatment-policy validation

used.name: pandas
used.evidence: src/mimic_demo_audit.py; joined public demo ICD, inputevents and item dictionaries and summarized real event rows

used.name: PhysioNet Parkinsonian Tremor database
used.evidence: src/parkinson_tremordb.py fetched and numerically analyzed 55 original fixed-condition finger-tremor records, results/parkinson_tremordb.json; neither adaptive stimulation trajectories nor LFP beta

used.name: Dryad movement-responsive aDBS figure dataset
used.evidence: src/parkinson_dryad_adaptive.py and results/parkinson_dryad_adaptive.json; public source ZIP verified SHA256, 8,389 time-indexed action rows from two hands of one participant, separate true movement and neural figure traces, no joined policy validation

used.name: Dryad eICU sepsis static risk cohort
used.evidence: src/sepsis_dryad_eicu_audit.py, results/sepsis_dryad_eicu.json; 13,717-row public TSV actually fetched, SHA256 verified and analyzed as a static first-day risk cohort; not treatment-policy trajectories

used.name: Figshare derived ICU sepsis immune trajectories (eICU and MIMIC-IV)
used.evidence: src/sepsis_figshare_immune.py, results/sepsis_figshare_immune.json; two public CSVs hashed and analyzed for daily NLR completeness and baseline retrospective outcome ranking; no treatment-policy trajectory validation
